PTP_GLOBAL_TEST.desc: Configure PTP global settings with domain number and intervals.

PTP_GLOBAL_DEFAULTS_TEST.desc: Configure PTP global with omitted intervals; YANG defaults apply (sync -3, announce 1).

PTP_GLOBAL_DOMAIN_INVALID_TEST.desc: Configure PTP global with out-of-range domain number (> 127).
eStr: PTP domain number must be in range 0..127

PTP_GLOBAL_SYNC_INTERVAL_INVALID_TEST.desc: Configure PTP global with out-of-range sync interval (> 7).
eStr: PTP sync interval must be in range -7..7

PTP_GLOBAL_ANNOUNCE_INTERVAL_INVALID_TES.desc: Configure PTP global with out-of-range announce interval (> 4).
eStr: PTP announce interval must be in range -3..4

PTP_PORT_TEST.desc: Configure a PTP port entry with a valid Ethernet interface.

PTP_PORT_WITH_UNICAST_TABLE_TEST.desc: Configure a PTP port entry with a unicast master table and unicast-listen enabled.

PTP_PORT_NON_EXIST_INTF_TEST.desc: Configure a PTP port entry referencing an interface that does not exist in PORT table.

PTP_PORT_NON_EXIST_UNICAST_TABLE_TEST.desc: Configure a PTP port entry referencing a unicast master table that does not exist.

PTP_UNICAST_MASTER_TABLE_TEST.desc: Create a PTP unicast master table entry.

PTP_UNICAST_MASTER_TABLE_INVALID_ID_TEST.desc: Create a PTP unicast master table entry with an out-of-range (negative) numeric ID.
eStr: Value "-1" is out of type uint32 min/max bounds.

PTP_UNICAST_MASTER_TABLE_IP_TEST.desc: Add an IPv4 address to a PTP unicast master table.

PTP_UNICAST_MASTER_TABLE_IPV6_TEST.desc: Add an IPv6 address to a PTP unicast master table.

PTP_UNICAST_MASTER_TABLE_IP_NON_EXIST_TA.desc: Add an IP to a PTP unicast master table that does not exist.
